name: Simple Storewide Sale for WooCommerce
author: wpgenie2

sections.description:
Simple Storewide Sale for WooCommerce provides a straightforward solution for applying store-wide discounts across your WooCommerce shop.

Unlike managing individual product sales or complex discount rules, this plugin allows you to set a single discount that applies across your entire catalog with configurable inclusion and exclusion options.

Features

  • Enable store-wide discounts for your entire product catalog
  • Set discount amount (percentage-based)
  • Schedule sales with start and end dates
  • Display store-wide sale notices to customers
  • Simple setup with minimal configuration

Use Cases

  • Seasonal sales and holiday promotions
  • Store-wide clearance events
  • Quick discount campaigns without editing individual products
  • Temporary promotions with specific product exclusions

PRO Features

All features of the free version, plus:

  • Flexible discount types: Choose between percentage or fixed amount discounts
  • Advanced filtering options: Extensive include/exclude controls for products, categories, SKUs, and tags
  • Pre-sale notifications: Display notices before sales begin to build anticipation
  • Sale product exclusions: Option to exclude products already on sale from store-wide discounts
  • Premium support: Direct access to our ticket support system at https://wpgenie.org/support/

Support

You can contact us at our website wpgenie.org if you have problems or questions.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or greater

Setup

This section describes how to install Simple Storewide Sale for WooCommerce plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce Settings and click tab Storewide Sale to enable storewide sale
  4. PRO version has option for fixed or percentage discounts
  5. PRO version has plenty of include / exclude filters
  6. PRO version has notice before sale starts
  7. PRO version has option to exclude products allready on sale

If you have any problems contact us at http://wpgenie.org/
sections.faq:
How storewide sale works? Does it update sale price for each product?

It uses filter to quickly change product price. Plugin does not update sale price for every product, that would be time consuming and would use a lot of resources to complete.

What features are in PRO version?

PRO version has option for fixed or percentage discounts, has plenty of include / exclude filters, has notice before sale starts and has option to exclude products allready on sale.

Have a question?

If you want answer here please send us your questions to info@wpgenie.org
